subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `sessions.activity`/`session.activity`/plugin-hook contract now, or wait for the broader canonical activity and attention-state design?
rationale: The branch defines new public Gateway and plugin SDK surfaces, but the canonical issue still has unresolved activity, attention, stale-run, child-rollup, and persistence semantics that automation should not choose for maintainers.

options.title: Approve A Canonical Contract First
options.body: Define the durable RPC/event/hook shape, attention model, stale-run handling, and child rollup before merging implementation work that plugins or clients may depend on.

options.title: Land A Narrow UI Slice
options.body: Keep the public SDK/API surface out of this branch and use existing task/session signals only for a limited Control UI activity strip.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave this PR blocked or close it later if maintainers prefer the merged Tasks page plus a separate canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Approve A Canonical Contract First
recommendation.body: Define the durable RPC/event/hook shape, attention model, stale-run handling, and child rollup before merging implementation work that plugins or clients may depend on.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee on the canonical activity contract and has recent Gateway/protocol history in the affected surface.
